item.ptxt: When work that changes the vehicle height, such as removal/installation or replacement of the height control sensor or replacement of the suspension, has been performed, or when the headlight leveling computer assembly has been replaced, perform initialization using procedure 1 or procedure 2 below.
After initializing the headlight leveling computer assembly, perform headlight aim adjustment.

s-1.ptxt: Headlight Leveling Computer Assembly Initialization Procedure (Initialization without TaSCAN)

s3.ptxt: Put the vehicle in the following condition.

item.ptxt: Reduce the remaining fuel to approximately 10 liters or less.
Unload any removable luggage from the vehicle. (Spare tire and on-board tools remain loaded)
Vehicle stopped with no change in vehicle height. (Vehicle stable on a level surface)

atten4.ptxt: If the above is not performed, initialization cannot be performed normally.

s3.ptxt: 3 seconds after turning the IG OFF → ON, check the headlight leveling warning light indication in the combination meter.

entry.ptxt: Initialization malfunction or headlight leveling computer assembly replaced (new)
Height control sensor replacement/removal, suspension replacement, etc.

atten4.ptxt: If not within the standard, inspect the headlight leveling computer assembly, wire harness and connectors.

s3.ptxt: Using SST, connect terminals 8 (LVL) and 4 (CG) of DLC3.
Within 20 seconds after connecting the initialization terminals, operate the light control switch OFF → HEAD 3 times or more. (*2)

atten3.ptxt: Operate the switch at 1 second intervals.

entry.ptxt: Blinks 2Hz2 times → blinks 2Hz3 times, then goes off (initialization completed normally)
Height control sensor replacement/removal, suspension replacement, etc.
No blinking → blinks 2Hz3 times, then goes off (initialization completed normally)

atten4.ptxt: If the operation (*2) does not finish normally even after repeating it 20 times or more, start again from step (*1).

s-1.ptxt: Headlight Leveling Computer Assembly Initialization Procedure (Initialization Using TaSCAN)

atten4.ptxt: When initializing the headlight leveling computer assembly using SST (TaSCAN), initialization can be performed without reducing the remaining fuel to approximately 10 liters or less.

s3.ptxt: Put the vehicle in the following condition. (*1)

item.ptxt: Unload any removable luggage from the vehicle. (Spare tire and on-board tools remain loaded)
Vehicle stopped with no change in vehicle height. (Vehicle stable on a level surface)

atten4.ptxt: If the above is not performed, initialization cannot be performed normally.

s3.ptxt: 3 seconds after turning the IG OFF → ON, check the headlight leveling warning light indication in the combination meter.

entry.ptxt: Initialization malfunction or headlight leveling computer assembly replaced (new)
Height control sensor replacement/removal, suspension replacement, etc.

atten4.ptxt: If not within the standard, inspect the headlight leveling computer assembly, wire harness and connectors.

s3.ptxt: With the IG OFF, connect SST (TaSCAN) to the DLC3 connector.
From the SST (TaSCAN) main menu, select "Utility → Auto Leveling → Height Sensor Initialization".
Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, press the "Start" button.
Check the needle position of the fuel receiver gauge, and determine the applicable position ID from the current needle position.

entry.ptxt: Less than 1/4 to EMPTY or more

s3.ptxt: Enter the applicable position ID into SST (TaSCAN) and press the "Register" button.

atten4.ptxt: The "Register" button cannot be pressed unless the position ID is entered.

entry.ptxt: Blinks 2Hz2 times → blinks 2Hz3 times, then goes off (initialization completed normally)
Height control sensor replacement/removal, suspension replacement, etc.
No blinking → blinks 2Hz3 times, then goes off (initialization completed normally)

atten4.ptxt: If it does not complete normally, redo the procedure from step (*1).

s3.ptxt: Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, press the "Complete" button.
